name: scaling-load-balancing-labs
description: Runnable labs for the Scaling & Load Balancing course: a fleet of app instances behind a load balancer you can read, with health checks you can break.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U lab -d fleet
scripts.nginx:reload: docker compose --profile nginx exec nginx nginx -s reload
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check fleet/instance.js && node --check lb/balancer.js
